verdict.rationale: Otter offers API/webhooks, unlimited file import, and cross-meeting search/analysis (e.g., 'analyze patterns and themes across multiple meetings', 'search meeting transcripts across all time periods') that could support automation across many meetings at once, but there is no explicit documentation of a bulk-edit/bulk-delete/bulk-tag operation or batch endpoint for acting on many items simultaneously. Missing for 10: documented bulk edit/delete/tag UI or API endpoints, evidence of batch processing limits/behavior, and independent confirmation that cross-meeting operations scale reliably.
